sections.heading: Unique Therapies at Prairie Sky Recovery

blocks.text: At Prairie Sky Recovery, they use a variety of unique and innovative therapies to help their clients overcome addiction. In addition to the traditional 12-Step program, they offer a range of evidence-based treatments like dialectical behavior therapy, motivational interviewing, and cognitive behavior therapy. They also offer mindfulness, communication, and assertiveness training, along with financial literacy programs. These therapies are designed to help clients address the root causes of their addiction and develop the skills they need to live a healthy and fulfilling life in recovery.

centre.name: Prairie Sky Recovery
centre.about_html:
Unique Therapies at Prairie Sky Recovery

At Prairie Sky Recovery, they use a variety of unique and innovative therapies to help their clients overcome addiction. In addition to the traditional 12-Step program, they offer a range of evidence-based treatments like dialectical behavior therapy, motivational interviewing, and cognitive behavior therapy. They also offer mindfulness, communication, and assertiveness training, along with financial literacy programs. These therapies are designed to help clients address the root causes of their addiction and develop the skills they need to live a healthy and fulfilling life in recovery.

 

Another unique aspect of Prairie Sky Recovery is their use of equine therapy. Horses can be incredibly therapeutic, helping individuals to build trust, improve their communication skills, and develop a sense of responsibility. At Prairie Sky Recovery, clients can participate in horse therapy sessions, guided by experienced professionals who understand the power of this unique treatment.

The Benefits of Whole Person Recovery at Prairie Sky

Prairie Sky Recovery takes a whole-person approach to addiction treatment, addressing every aspect of a client’s physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual health. This holistic approach recognizes that addiction is a complex disease that requires a multi-faceted treatment approach.

 

By treating the whole person, Prairie Sky Recovery helps clients to heal from the inside out. They work with each individual to develop a personalized treatment plan that addresses their unique needs and helps them build the skills they need to create a successful and lasting recovery.

The Serenity of Prairie Sky Recovery

One of the most significant benefits of seeking treatment at Prairie Sky Recovery is the serene location of the center. Situated on six acres of beautifully landscaped grounds, surrounded by the stunning natural beauty of rural Saskatchewan, Prairie Sky Recovery provides a tranquil and peaceful environment for clients to heal.

 

The historic 20,000 square foot facility has been lovingly restored and renovated to provide all the modern comforts clients need while maintaining its original charm and character. Clients can stay in private or semi-private rooms, each offering a peaceful and relaxing retreat from the outside world.

Addiction Treatment for Everyone

 

Prairie Sky Recovery is committed to helping everyone who needs addiction treatment, regardless of their background, religion, or sexual orientation. Their evidence-based approach to addiction treatment is effective for people of all colors, creeds, and orientations.

 

They are nonjudgmental and provide a safe and supportive environment for clients to heal. Whether you are struggling with substance abuse, alcohol addiction, or non-substance addiction, Prairie Sky Recovery can help.




Prairie Sky Recovery - Center Overview

Prairie Sky Recovery Centre is a leading facility for providing evidence-based addiction recovery programs. The centre is based on a relational approach that addresses the entire person, including physical, mental, emotional and spiritual aspects. The rehabilitation programs offered by the centre are personalized and catered to each individual client, making them client-centered and effective.

One of the unique features of their programs is the inclusion of all 12 steps, cognitive behavior therapy, and dialectical behavioral therapy, among others. Their staff is experienced, empathetic, and caring, with many individuals having lived experience with addiction. Their philosophy of providing addiction recovery support is applied throughout the centre, which is why they were recipients of the 2018 BBB Torch Award and a finalist for the Chamber ABEX award in 2018 and 2019. Prairie Sky Recovery Centre is committed to enhancing successful addiction recovery through their supportive, caring approach that builds recovery capital and leaves clients with a healthy and sustainable pathway forward.

Frequently Asked Questions About Prairie Sky Recovery

Will I be required to participate in the 12-Step program at Prairie Sky Recovery?

Yes, the 12-Step program is part of our overall treatment approach at Prairie Sky Recovery, but we offer a range of other evidence-based therapies as well.

Can my family participate in my treatment at Prairie Sky Recovery?

Yes, we offer a 2-day psychoeducation program for families of clients to participate in.

How long is the program at Prairie Sky Recovery?

Our programs range from 30 to 90 days, depending on the needs of each individual client.

What types of addiction does Prairie Sky Recovery treat?

We treat all kinds of addiction, including substance abuse, alcohol addiction, and non-substance addictions such as gambling and food addiction.

Can I bring my pet to Prairie Sky Recovery?

No, we cannot allow pets at our facility due to the potential for disruption to other clients and staff.

raw_html:
Unique Therapies at Prairie Sky Recovery

At Prairie Sky Recovery, they use a variety of unique and innovative therapies to help their clients overcome addiction. In addition to the traditional 12-Step program, they offer a range of evidence-based treatments like dialectical behavior therapy, motivational interviewing, and cognitive behavior therapy. They also offer mindfulness, communication, and assertiveness training, along with financial literacy programs. These therapies are designed to help clients address the root causes of their addiction and develop the skills they need to live a healthy and fulfilling life in recovery.

 

Another unique aspect of Prairie Sky Recovery is their use of equine therapy. Horses can be incredibly therapeutic, helping individuals to build trust, improve their communication skills, and develop a sense of responsibility. At Prairie Sky Recovery, clients can participate in horse therapy sessions, guided by experienced professionals who understand the power of this unique treatment.

The Benefits of Whole Person Recovery at Prairie Sky

Prairie Sky Recovery takes a whole-person approach to addiction treatment, addressing every aspect of a client’s physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual health. This holistic approach recognizes that addiction is a complex disease that requires a multi-faceted treatment approach.

 

By treating the whole person, Prairie Sky Recovery helps clients to heal from the inside out. They work with each individual to develop a personalized treatment plan that addresses their unique needs and helps them build the skills they need to create a successful and lasting recovery.

The Serenity of Prairie Sky Recovery

One of the most significant benefits of seeking treatment at Prairie Sky Recovery is the serene location of the center. Situated on six acres of beautifully landscaped grounds, surrounded by the stunning natural beauty of rural Saskatchewan, Prairie Sky Recovery provides a tranquil and peaceful environment for clients to heal.

 

The historic 20,000 square foot facility has been lovingly restored and renovated to provide all the modern comforts clients need while maintaining its original charm and character. Clients can stay in private or semi-private rooms, each offering a peaceful and relaxing retreat from the outside world.

Addiction Treatment for Everyone

 

Prairie Sky Recovery is committed to helping everyone who needs addiction treatment, regardless of their background, religion, or sexual orientation. Their evidence-based approach to addiction treatment is effective for people of all colors, creeds, and orientations.

 

They are nonjudgmental and provide a safe and supportive environment for clients to heal. Whether you are struggling with substance abuse, alcohol addiction, or non-substance addiction, Prairie Sky Recovery can help.




Prairie Sky Recovery - Center Overview

Prairie Sky Recovery Centre is a leading facility for providing evidence-based addiction recovery programs. The centre is based on a relational approach that addresses the entire person, including physical, mental, emotional and spiritual aspects. One of the unique features of their programs is the inclusion of all 12 steps, cognitive behavior therapy, and dialectical behavioral therapy, among others. Their staff is experienced, empathetic, and caring, with many individuals having lived experience with addiction. Their philosophy of providing addiction recovery support is applied throughout the centre, which is why they were recipients of the 2018 BBB Torch Award and a finalist for the Chamber ABEX award in 2018 and 2019. Prairie Sky Recovery Centre is committed to enhancing successful addiction recovery through their supportive, caring approach that builds recovery capital and leaves clients with a healthy and sustainable pathway forward.

Frequently Asked Questions About Prairie Sky Recovery

Will I be required to participate in the 12-Step program at Prairie Sky Recovery?

Yes, the 12-Step program is part of our overall treatment approach at Prairie Sky Recovery, but we offer a range of other evidence-based therapies as well.

Can my family participate in my treatment at Prairie Sky Recovery?

Yes, we offer a 2-day psychoeducation program for families of clients to participate in.

How long is the program at Prairie Sky Recovery?

Our programs range from 30 to 90 days, depending on the needs of each individual client.

What types of addiction does Prairie Sky Recovery treat?

We treat all kinds of addiction, including substance abuse, alcohol addiction, and non-substance addictions such as gambling and food addiction.

Can I bring my pet to Prairie Sky Recovery?

No, we cannot allow pets at our facility due to the potential for disruption to other clients and staff.
